import json, sys, time, subprocess; sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import ktest, obj, run
from collections import Counter

# a chain of 4000 filters: entry pipes f0, f0 pipes f1, ...
NF = 4000
types = [{"name": "U8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8}]
modules = [{"name": "entry", "params": [["a", "U8"]], "result": ["r", "U8"],
            "requires": ["lt", ["var", "a"], ["const", "U8", 200]]}]
for i in range(NF):
    modules.append({"name": "f%d" % i, "params": [["q", "U8"]], "result": ["o", "U8"],
                    "requires": ["ne", ["var", "q"], ["const", "U8", i % 250]]})
pipes = [{"target": "entry", "filter": "f0", "bind": {"q": "a"}}]
for i in range(NF - 1):
    pipes.append({"target": "f%d" % i, "filter": "f%d" % (i + 1), "bind": {"q": "q"}})
doc = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": pipes, "entries": ["entry"],
       "machine": None, "runs": []}
t = time.time()
g = run(doc)
print("compile+empty %.2fs" % (time.time() - t))
print("modules", len(g["plans"][0]["modules"]), "flag", g["plans"][0]["flag"],
      "variables", g["plans"][0]["variables"])
assert g["plans"][0]["modules"][0] == "f%d" % (NF - 1) and g["plans"][0]["modules"][-1] == "entry"
assert len(g["plans"][0]["modules"]) == NF + 1
# harness: a x0, r x1, flag x2
# all filters accept when a is not equal to any i%250 for i in 0..3999 -> impossible for a<200?
# a in 0..199; i%250 == a happens for i in a, a+250, ... so a filter rejects whenever i%250 == a.
# Since i ranges over 0..3999, i%250 covers 0..249 multiple times -> every a<200 is rejected.
doc["runs"] = [{"entry": "entry", "ktest": ktest([obj("x0", 5, 1), obj("x1", 0, 1), obj("x2", 1, 1)])}]
t = time.time()
g = run(doc)
print("one run %.2fs" % (time.time() - t))
print(g["records"])
assert g["records"][0]["status"] == "FILTERED"
print("PASS deep pipe chain (4000 composed applications)")
